course.title: Digital Communications
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value: A television channel has a bandwidth of 4.5 MHz. The signal is sampled, quantized and (06) binary coded to obtain a PCM signal. If the signal is to be sampled at a rate 20% above the Nyquist rate and quantized into 1024 levels, determine the binary pulse rate (bps) of the encoded signal and the minimum bandwidth required to transmit the signal.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
